intent: A compact "what moved" card for a period: each metric shows before → after and a delta pill. Good and bad are set per metric (churn down is good), and direction and sentiment are always spelled out.
useWhen: summarise the changes between two periods on a dashboard or report
say whether each move is good or bad for the business
doNotUseWhen: one KPI with a trend — Scorecard
a row of KPI tiles — Scoreboard

items.note: { id, label, before, after, delta, direction: 'up'|'down'|'flat', sentiment?: 'good'|'bad'|'neutral' }[] — values are pre-formatted strings.

requirements: each row reads as one sentence, e.g. "MRR up +9.8%, good. $48.2K to $52.9K."; the visual row is aria-hidden
the word good, bad or neutral is visible next to the values, not colour alone
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local DeltaList or MetricChanges
Do not colour by direction: sentiment is set per metric
Do not show arrows without the word
